name: texlance
description: Pylance-style LaTeX preamble intelligence for VS Code: resolves the preamble against kpsewhich and reports unresolved packages, plus path-aware completions.

texlance.analysis.extraPaths.markdownDescription: Additional paths searched **recursively** (depth-capped) for `.sty`/`.cls` files when resolving `\usepackage`, `\RequirePackage` and `\documentclass`. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder. Mirrors `python.analysis.extraPaths`.

texlance.analysis.reportMissingPackages.markdownDescription: Severity of the `reportMissingPackages` diagnostic raised for a package or class that cannot be resolved by `kpsewhich`, an extra path or the document folder.

texlance.kpsewhichPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the `kpsewhich` executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (`PATH`, `/Library/TeX/texbin`, TeX Live and MiKTeX installs).

texlance.preamble.maxLines.markdownDescription: Maximum number of lines scanned for preamble commands. The scan always stops early at `\begin{document}`.

texlance.completion.enabled.description: Offer command, package and class completions.

texlance.trace.server.description: Trace the communication between VS Code and the TeXlance language server.

commands.title: Refresh Package Index
commands.description: Re-scan kpsewhich (ls-R) databases, extra paths and the workspace for .sty/.cls files.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:tests
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build && npm run build:tests
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
